title: Delayed conveyor
brief: Program a conveyor that starts only after a continuous run request has lasted for 5 seconds.
requirements: Run Request (I0.0) is ON while the operator wants the conveyor to run. Conveyor Motor (Q0.0) must start only after Run Request has been continuously ON for 5 seconds.
Initially, Conveyor Motor (Q0.0) must be OFF. When Run Request (I0.0) turns ON, begin the 5-second delay but keep the motor OFF.
Once Run Request has remained ON for the full 5 seconds, switch Conveyor Motor (Q0.0) ON and keep it ON while the request remains active.
If Run Request (I0.0) turns OFF at any point, stop Conveyor Motor immediately and reset the elapsed delay to zero.
When Run Request turns ON again, a completely new 5-second delay must begin. Several shorter requests must not add together.
objective: Understand on-delay timing and reset behaviour.
hints: A TON accumulates time while IN is TRUE and resets on FALSE.
Create a TON instance (e.g. Delay_DB) with PT T#5s, then use Delay_DB.Q as an NO contact in a separate output network.
